mods.name: Age of Miracles
mods.author: Wololoader
mods.description: Adds the Age of Miracles lobby game mode. Monks generate Faith every 10 seconds, spent at the Monastery on Miracles (Bountiful Harvest, Holy Warriors, Plague, Divine Favour). First player to reach the Faith target wins!

mods.name: Faith and Relics
mods.author: Wololoader
mods.description: Adds a Faith custom resource generated by Monks (+1 Faith per Monk every 10 seconds). Example of custom resources in mod.json and Lua.

mods.name: Last Stand
mods.author: Wololoader
mods.description: Co-op zombies-style survival mode. Every player, computer players included, defends one shared Castle against the Horde: endless rounds of Gaia raiders that spawn all around your bases and march on your buildings. Earn Points from kills and survived rounds, then spend them at the Castle on Mystery Boxes, perks (Juggernaut, Speed Cola, Pack-a-Punch), mercenaries, towers and supplies.

mods.name: Merchant Caravans
mods.author: Wololoader
mods.description: Trade caravans visit your town every few minutes and bring resources. Example of mod settings: pick how often they come, how much they bring and what, on the Mods screen (Settings).

mods.name: Monklanians
mods.author: ali
mods.description: Adds the Monklanians, a Briton-based civilization of tough, fast-walking monks with longer conversion range. The example civ mod of Wololoader.

mods.name: Woodlanders
mods.author: ali
mods.description: Adds the Woodlanders, a Frankish forest people of fast lumberjacks and heavy axe riders. Second example civ of Wololoader (unique unit cloned from the Knight).
